# Why is your BigQuery bill so high?

> Paste your BigQuery query groups (runs per month, GB billed, slot-hours) and see on-demand vs Editions cost, the expensive queries to cap with maximum_bytes_billed, and repeat large scans. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
